genZNote: Turns sugar into acid and acid into cavities — the actual reason your dentist cares about flossing.

habitat.naturalHabitat: Human oral cavity, especially dental plaque on tooth surfaces
habitat.hostAssociation: A primary constituent of dental plaque biofilm; strongly associated with tooth surfaces rather than mucosa

culture.growthCharacteristics: Facultative anaerobe; grows better with added CO2
culture.hemolysis: Alpha-hemolytic or non-hemolytic (viridans group), variable by strain

biochemicalTests.result: Resistant (distinguishes viridans strep from S. pneumoniae)

identificationClues: Produces glucosyltransferase, forming the glucan matrix of dental plaque biofilm
Gram-positive coccus in chains, catalase negative
Alpha-hemolytic or non-hemolytic on blood agar — part of the viridans streptococcus group
Optochin resistant and bile-insoluble, distinguishing it from Streptococcus pneumoniae

diseases: Dental caries (tooth decay) — primary etiologic agent
Rare infective endocarditis (viridans group mechanism, following dental procedures/bacteremia)
virulenceFactors: Glucosyltransferase — synthesizes extracellular glucan that builds dental plaque biofilm and adheres to tooth enamel
Acid production (lactic acid) from dietary sugars — demineralizes tooth enamel
clinicalImportance.transmission: Transmitted via saliva (e.g., caregiver to child); colonizes tooth surfaces after eruption
clinicalImportance.epidemiology: The leading cause of dental caries worldwide; sugar-rich diets and poor oral hygiene promote biofilm formation and acid-mediated enamel damage
clinicalImportance.labSignificance: Diagnosis of caries is clinical/radiographic; S. mutans is not typically cultured in routine practice

examFacts.keyBiochemicalReaction: Catalase negative; produces glucan from sucrose via glucosyltransferase; ferments carbohydrates to lactic acid
examFacts.importantDisease: Dental caries (tooth decay) — primary etiologic agent
examFacts.importantTest: Optochin resistance and bile insolubility distinguish viridans strep from S. pneumoniae
examFacts.distinguishingFeature: The main causative organism of dental caries — uses glucosyltransferase to build the biofilm that lets it stick to enamel and demineralize it with acid
